title: THE LAST FLIGHT

cards.title: ARTIFACT RECOVERED
cards.text: The recovered object is prepared for transport.

cards.title: TRANSPORT DEPARTS
cards.text: John leaves aboard the transport carrying the artifact.

cards.title: RADIO CONTACT LOST
cards.text: The operation loses contact with John's transport.

cards.title: AIRCRAFT GOES DOWN
cards.text: Alex witnesses the aircraft go down.

cards.title: RECORDS RESTRICTED
cards.text: The agency restricts the operation's records after the incident.

cards.title: BODY IDENTIFIED
cards.text: A recovery team identifies John's body.

cards.title: ARTIFACT RETURNED
cards.text: The artifact is checked back into agency storage.

cards.title: MURDER CONFIRMED
cards.text: The agency confirms that John was murdered.

evidence.title: HANDOVER NOTE
evidence.text: The object was recovered before departure. The dispatch record refers to this completed handover.

evidence.title: DISPATCH RECORD
evidence.text: After the handover, the transport departed with McClane and the recovered object aboard.

evidence.title: RADIO LOG
evidence.text: Contact was lost after departure. Alex's account places the unanswered calls before the aircraft went down.

evidence.title: ALEX'S ACCOUNT
evidence.text: After the unanswered calls, I saw the aircraft go down. I did not see a survivor. I do not believe John could have survived.

evidence.title: RECORDS AMENDMENT
evidence.text: Following the reported crash, the agency placed supporting records in restricted circulation.

evidence.title: RECOVERY STATUS
evidence.text: No body was recovered or identified. The exact crash site was not established in these records.

evidence.title: ASSET REGISTER
evidence.text: The artifact has no completed return entry. A departure record is not proof that it came back.

evidence.title: FINDING STATUS
evidence.text: These documents establish a reported crash and restricted records. They do not establish a murder.

conclusions.label: PRESUMED DEAD
conclusions.explanation: Alex's account supports presumed death. No recovered body means it is not confirmed.

conclusions.label: CONFIRMED DEAD
conclusions.explanation: No body was recovered or identified. The records do not confirm death.

conclusions.label: CONFIRMED ALIVE
conclusions.explanation: No evidence currently establishes that John survived.

success: The aircraft went down with John and the artifact unaccounted for. Alex believes John died. The records support presumed death, not a confirmed identification and not a proven murder.
